# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security updates are actively maintained on the latest release of AetherFlix:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in AetherFlix, please report it privately:

1. **GitHub Security Advisories**: Submit an advisory via the [Security Advisories tab](https://github.com/HBL-LL/aetherflix/security/advisories/new).
2. Please provide:
   - A detailed description of the vulnerability.
   - Steps to reproduce or a proof of concept (PoC).
   - Any suggested remediations or mitigations.

We take security issues seriously and will investigate, patch, and release fixes promptly.
